parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID from assays, target_type and tax_id from target_dictionary, canonical_smiles from compound_structures, molecule ChEMBL ID from molecule_dictionary, standard_type and pchembl_value from activities. Join target_dictionary to assays on tid, assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1835', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Return the first 1000 rows.
